title: Käsespätzle mit Kokosnuss
description: A German twist on the classic spätzle dish, featuring a coconut and cheese sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the shredded coconut and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut milk and a pinch of salt.
Add the coconut milk mixture to the saucepan with the coconut and butter, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the sauce for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the cooked pasta and return it to the pot.
Add the cheese sauce to the pasta and toss to combine.
Serve the Käsespätzle hot, topped with additional shredded coconut if desired.
